title: Triage verdict
description: One investigator's verdict on one open issue. Written as verdicts/<n>.json by an investigator agent following references/investigator-brief.md; read and validated by scripts/build-report.py. Stay inside the JSON Schema subset build-report.py implements: type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties (boolean), items, minItems, minLength, and $ref into $defs.

verdict.description: Exactly one outcome. references/investigator-brief.md defines each.

confidence.description: How sure you are AFTER your tests, not before.

summary.description: <=60 words: what the issue is, what you found, what the maintainer should do.

evidence.description: One entry per load-bearing assertion in the report.

changed_since_baseline.description: One line: what changed in the relevant files since the prior triage baseline, or 'none'. Omit when there is no prior triage.

recommended_action.description: keep, comment and close map onto the action field of the actions file scripts/apply-triage-actions.py consumes. needs-maintainer means the maintainer must decide before anything is posted.

draft_reply.description: 2-6 sentences the maintainer could paste: specific, evidence-based, kind to good-faith reporters, firm on slop, no timelines. Empty string if no reply is warranted.

live_repro_design.description: Required when the verdict is NEED_LIVE_REPRO: the wave-2 scenario. null otherwise.

fixture.description: Exactly what the fixture directory must contain for the run to be meaningful.

prompt.description: The neutral user prompt, verbatim. Must not hint at the expected failure.

model.description: The cheapest model tier that could settle this. Wave 2 runs exactly this.

decisive_observation.description: The single observation that settles the question either way.

reps.description: How many reps to run, up to the wave-2 rep cap.

live_repro.description: Wave-2 results. Absent or null until wave 2 has run this design.

reproduced.description: Reps in which the decisive observation occurred.

void.description: Reps that timed out, refused, or failed for unrelated reasons.

workers.description: Worker session names, one per rep.

notes.description: Confounds, deviations from the design, anything the maintainer needs in order to weigh the number.

claim.description: The assertion being tested, in the reporter's terms.

test.description: The exact command or reading, so it can be re-run.

result.description: What was observed. Quote over paraphrase.

duplicates_of.description: Canonical issue number if this is a duplicate.
